description: agent-bus hooks: SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit run the inbox bridge, which prints unread bus messages addressed to claude@<repo> as plain text (Claude Code adds exit-0 stdout to context for both events) and acks them on delivery. Silent, exit 0, when there is no mail, when the daemon is unreachable, or when stdin is not what a hook sends, so a down daemon never turns into a per-prompt error. Exec form via uv so a client machine needs uv and nothing installed; the CLI is stdlib-only, hence --no-project. Timeout is in seconds and generous for a hook that gates nothing: a stall is visible, and there is no silent-bypass mode to protect against.
